I built the kvhttp server in Rust (edition 2024) using `tokio` and `hyper`, and all 4 example cases pass under `node check.mjs`.

I also tested some cases by hand against a running server:
- **Large values:** a 1 MiB random value stored and came back byte-for-byte identical.
- **Concurrency:** 100 PUTs sent at once all returned `201`, and `GET /kv` listed the keys sorted.
- **Errors:** `POST /kv` returned `405`, and an empty-body PUT returned `201` with `Content-Length: 0`.
